svg.title: Actual Gaussian image fitting over 200 Adam steps
svg.desc: Three vector images show the fixed target, initial five-splat render, and fitted render. All are 32 by 32 RGB images. The computed loss falls from 0.140337 to 0.000318. SSIM increases from 0.593635 to 0.999987.
svg.text: Five splats, with L = 0.8 L1 + 0.2 (1 − SSIM)
